next_unit_hint: This design cannot audit the credit itself: the cached series is a deterministic staircase reproduced bit-identically under a new salt, so a 'fresh run' is the same function of prompt length as U15. To falsify the stale-credit model directly, measure rows whose credit the server must recompute (re-send an identical prompt, or a cache-disabled control) rather than a longer staircase. Until then the repair's 12.6-20.8 % swing has no live support.
